answers.question: platform 3: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: Not so in OSM: platforms 3a/4a are reached by Trädgårdslänken (stairs w1206809266, lifts n12442354267), the tunnels (escalator w1337836810, stairs w1337836811, lift n13201141894) and ramps (w1390577054, w1436230597). Only in OSM; the Region Värmland overview map of 4 May 2026 could not be downloaded (the link returns a web page).

answers.question: platform 21: no stairs, escalator or lift of its own
answers.answer: In OSM platform 21 is reached by the ramp w71552940, which also serves 1a/1b (a ramp, no stairs or lift). Only in OSM.
